PORTAL_GROUPS.TITLE: Groups
PORTAL_GROUPS.DESCRIPTION: WhatsApp campaign audiences. Click a group to see its contacts. New company contacts join on their own and anyone deactivated leaves on their own.

CREATE.TITLE: New group
CREATE.DESCRIPTION: Give it a name and check the companies. All their active contacts receive.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit group
EDIT.ACTIVE_HINT: An inactive group is hidden from campaigns and receives nothing.

PICKER.ERROR: Could not load companies and contacts.
PICKER.COMPANIES_DESCRIPTION: Check the group's companies. All their active contacts receive.
PICKER.CONTACTS_DESCRIPTION: Individual contacts: they join the group without the whole company.
PICKER.SEARCH_COMPANIES: Search company by name or document
PICKER.SEARCH_CONTACTS: Search contact by name, phone, email or company

PANEL.EMPTY: No contacts yet. Link companies or add contacts.
PANEL.EMPTY_AUTOMATIC: No active client receives right now.
